cases.revert_guidance: Revert the candidate field access change when this case is below 0.98x or the release suite is below its overall gate.
Revert the candidate method dispatch change when this case is below 0.98x or the release suite is below its overall gate.
Revert the candidate inherited lookup change when this case is below 0.98x or the release suite is below its overall gate.

Revert the candidate string key change when this case is below 0.98x or the release suite is below its overall gate.
Revert the candidate interpolation change when this case is below 0.98x or the release suite is below its overall gate.
Revert the candidate global lookup change when this case is below 0.98x or the release suite is below its overall gate.
Revert the candidate allocation change when this case is below 0.98x, peak memory regresses materially, or the release suite is below its overall gate.
Revert the cache candidate when method resolution is below 0.98x, the target 1.05x gain is absent after stable measurement, or cache correctness checks fail.
Revert the worker candidate when round trips are below 0.98x, the target 1.05x gain is absent after stable measurement, or worker shutdown and error tests regress.
Revert the serialization candidate when JSON round trips are below 0.98x, the target 1.10x gain is absent after stable measurement, or byte and error compatibility tests regress.
Revert the SQLite candidate when in-memory statement work is below 0.98x, the target 1.05x gain is absent after stable measurement, or query and binding tests regress.
Revert the receive-line candidate when loopback line reads are below 0.98x, the target 1.10x gain is absent after stable measurement, or receive limits and buffering tests regress.
Revert the time constructor candidate when constructor work is below 0.98x, the target 1.10x gain is absent after stable measurement, or fastcall parity tests regress.

pgo.revert_guidance: Ship the plain release build when the stable PGO suite is below 1.05x overall, any valid case is below 0.98x, or profile generation is not reproducible.
